title: Majority Element II
statement: Return every element that appears more than n / 3 times, sorted. There are at most two such elements.
hints: A hash map is the direct count.
Boyer-Moore generalizes to two candidates, because more than two values cannot each exceed n / 3.
A second pass verifies the candidates. The vote can name a value that does not actually qualify.

approaches.name: Count
approaches.explanation: Filter values whose count exceeds n / 3.

editorial: Keep two candidates and two counts. A match increments. An empty slot takes the value. Otherwise both counts decrement, which cancels one of each. After the vote, count the candidates for real and keep those above n / 3. Sort the result.
